title: T1586.003 — Compromise Accounts - Cloud Accounts
subtitle: Watch the full attack story: stolen credentials bought from a log market, a takeover of an AWS account, and the security operations center (SOC - the team that watches alerts...
aria: Animated diagram of the attack story. A full text version follows in the written steps below.

steps.title: Buy stealer logs with cloud creds
steps.caption: An attacker buys stealer logs on a criminal market. The logs hold passwords, cookies, and session tokens taken from infected computers.
steps.defender: None. Stealer logs are sold in bulk on criminal markets; monitoring leak feeds is the only early warning.

detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Console login without MFA
steps.caption: The attacker signs in to the AWS console with a stolen password. No MFA is enforced, so the session opens.
steps.defender: CloudTrail ConsoleLogin with MFAUsed=No from a new network - top-priority alert.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Enumerate permissions
steps.caption: Inside the session, the attacker runs IAM list and read calls to map users, roles, and permissions.
steps.defender: Rare List/Get API burst from a new principal.

fields.detail: Inside the session, the attacker runs IAM list and read calls to map users, roles, and permissions.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Create rogue IAM user + keys
steps.caption: The attacker creates a rogue IAM user and long-lived access keys. The backdoor survives a password reset.
steps.defender: New IAM user + access keys outside the joiner process (the standard steps for giving a new employee access) - critical.

steps.title: Launch VMs for attack infrastructure
steps.caption: The attacker launches virtual machines in an unusual region to use as attack infrastructure.
steps.defender: Unusual instance launches; billing alarms fire.

fields.detail: The attacker launches virtual machines in an unusual region to use as attack infrastructure.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Download the data bucket
steps.caption: The attacker bulk-reads a storage bucket with repeated GetObject calls.
steps.defender: GetObject volume spike; GuardDuty exfiltration finding.

fields.detail: The attacker bulk-reads a storage bucket with repeated GetObject calls.

detection.label: Partial signal
detection.detail: A weak signal exists but is not yet a confirmed alert.

steps.title: Cover tracks
steps.caption: The attacker tries to stop or delete the CloudTrail trail to hide the activity.
steps.defender: Trail changes are themselves logged - alert on them.

fields.detail: The attacker tries to stop or delete the CloudTrail trail to hide the activity.

detection.label: Alert raised
detection.detail: The SOC has enough evidence to open an incident.

steps.title: SOC response
steps.caption: The SOC disables keys, deletes the rogue user, revokes sessions, and rotates credentials.
steps.defender: Keys disabled; rogue user removed; root-cause review of the stealer infection.

fields.detail: The SOC disables keys, deletes the rogue user, revokes sessions, and rotates credentials.

detection.label: Contained
detection.detail: The activity is contained and the lesson is captured.
